# Wodonga Skip Bins

> Skip bins in Wodonga, West Wodonga, Baranduda, Killara, Leneva and Bandiana. Tell us your suburb, size and waste type and get a free quote from one local skip bin operator.

Wodonga Skip Bins (wodongaskipbins.com) is a free skip bin quote and referral service, not a skip hire company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, skip size, waste type, then contact details) and the request goes to one local skip bin operator, who quotes, supplies the skip and sets the price and hire terms.

- Service: skip bin hire quotes
- Area: Wodonga, Wodonga Council (VIC), including West Wodonga, Killara, Baranduda, Leneva, Huon Creek, Castle Creek, Ebden, Barnawartha North, Bandiana, Bonegilla
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: no price list; a local operator will quote for each job

## Quick answers

- **What areas does Wodonga Skip Bins cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take skip bin quote requests from Wodonga and nearby areas, including West Wodonga, Killara, Baranduda, Leneva, Huon Creek, Castle Creek, Ebden, Barnawartha North, Bandiana, Bonegilla. The quote service is free, so there's no call-out fee from us. The operator includes delivery and pick-up in its quote. Deliveries out to Bonegilla, Huon Creek or Barnawartha North, extra hire days and difficult access can add to the price.
- **Do I need a licence or permit for a skip bin?** You don't need a licence to hire a skip. A skip wholly on your own property generally doesn't need approval. On a road or nature strip, yes: Wodonga Council requires a Permit to Place a Bulk Rubbish Container (Skip Bin) on Council Land. Its 2025–26 fee is $54.70. Asbestos is different: asbestos can't go in a general skip. In Victoria, friable asbestos must be removed by a WorkSafe-licensed removalist, and homeowners are limited to small amounts (up to 10 m²) of bonded asbestos.
- **What affects the price of a skip bin?** Skip bin prices depend on the bin size, the type and weight of the waste, how long you keep the bin, how far the truck travels and how easy access is. We don't publish a price list. Tell us about your job and a local operator will quote for it.
- **Who supplies the skip?** Wodonga Skip Bins is a free referral and quote service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't own skips or trucks. We pass your request to one local skip bin operator who services your area, and they quote, supply the skip and set the hire terms.
